answer_1.quote: For our SFT experiments, we selected benchmarks to cover a wide range of capabilities. Specifically, we use HellaSwag for knowledge understanding, Wino-Grande for language understanding, and RACE for reading reasoning capabilities. For grounding and abstractive summarization, we employ PIQA . To evaluate more specialized skills, we utilize HumanEval (Chen et al., 2021) for coding, T-Eval (Chen et al., 2024) for tool use, and Xstory_cloze for multi-turn dialogues and multilingual tasks.
answer_1.outputs: generated answers to QA tasks, code snippets, tool-use responses

answer_2.quote: we introduce two stringent metrics. First, we measure minimum accuracy on the test set of 50 unseen prompts to evaluate worst‑case performance under normal conditions. Second, we assess conditional accuracy (Con) on a challenging set of 10 adversarially crafted prompts containing paraphrases, misspellings, or other modifications to measure resilience against noisy inputs.
